sections.title: Introduction
sections.content:
MultiWeb Manager is an application combining browser functions, developer tools, task management, projects, notes, and a set of Tools.

On the left is the Sidebar – navigation center. On the right – WebView, Notepad, TaskPanel, Tools and other modules.

sections.title: Sidebar & Profiles
sections.content:
Sidebar contains:
- profile search bar,
- categories (AI, Dev, Design, Productivity, Special),
- profile list,
- recently used,
- Tools,
- App Library,
- Settings,
- Help.

Each profile is a separate app opened in WebView.
You can:
- add profiles,
- edit them in modals,
- change order (drag & drop),
- pin (isPinned),
- mark as favorite (isFavorite),
- set as default (isDefault),
- add notes and labels,
- set userAgent,
- enable/disable AdBlocker per profile.

sections.title: WebView & Browser
sections.content:
Each profile opens in WebView with a full toolbar:
- Back / Forward
- Refresh
- Address Bar (readonly or editable)
- Copy URL
- Open in Browser
- Zoom In / Out
- DevTools
- Clear Cache
- Screenshot WebView
- Single App Mode
- Resource Monitor

Additional features:
- Sleep Tabs – inactive tab sleep
- AdBlocker global + per profile
- Tile View – multiple WebViews side by side
- Custom User Agent

sections.title: Notepad
sections.content:
Notepad works like a tabbed editor:
- multi-tab,
- rename tabs,
- autosave only on change,
- plain text mode,
- syntax highlight (CodeMirror/Monaco),
- rich text (bold, italic, lists).

Notes are saved automatically and persistently.

sections.title: TaskPanel & Tasks
sections.content:
TaskPanel allows:
- adding tasks (TaskModal),
- editing tasks,
- filtering by priority (A–E),
- searching tasks,
- marking as done,
- assigning to projects,
- setting due dates,
- rich text description.

Tasks are saved in tasksStore.

sections.title: Projects & AggregatedTasks
sections.content:
ProjectManager lets you create projects with description and status (active/archived).

AggregatedTasks displays tasks grouped by project:
- task count,
- collapse/expand,
- hide/show,
- sorting,
- integration with TaskPanel.

Visibility settings are saved in settings.aggregatedTasks.

sections.title: Terminal
sections.content:
Terminal is based on node-pty + xterm.js.

Features:
- full command support,
- ANSI coloring,
- command history (up/down arrows),
- session restart,
- clear,
- event listener cleanup,
- integration with preload.js and main.js.

Terminal runs in a separate container and does not block UI.

sections.title: Tools
sections.content:
Available tools:
- JSON/YAML/XML Formatter
- Regex Tester
- Markdown Previewer
- Image Tools (compress/resize/convert)
- SVG → PNG Converter
- File Previewer
- Mini Postman (API Tester)
- Clipboard History
- Cookie Grabber

Each tool has its own component and entry in helpData.

sections.title: Settings
sections.content:
Settings contains:
- language (PL/EN),
- theme (dark/light/system),
- debugMode,
- API keys,
- hotkeys manager,
- export/import settings,
- logs folder,
- Sleep Tabs timeout,
- Resource Monitor thresholds,
- AdBlocker global,
- Address Bar editable,
- default profile categories.

Settings are merged – never overwritten.

sections.title: App Library
sections.content:
App Library is a list of ready-to-use apps divided into categories.

Each app has:
- id
- name
- url
- icon
- isPinned
- isDefault
- isFavorite

You can add an app to Sidebar with one click.

sections.title: Advanced Features
sections.content:
Advanced application features:
- Single App Mode – open profile in a separate window
- Resource Monitor – WebView RAM/CPU usage
- Sleep Tabs – inactive tab sleep
- Screenshot WebView – save to clipboard
- Cookie Grabber – get cookies from WebView
- Tile View – multiple WebViews side by side
- Unified Search – global search (Ctrl+K)
- Quick Switcher – quick switching (Ctrl+P)

sections.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
sections.content:
Global shortcuts:
- Ctrl+K — Unified Search
- Ctrl+P — Quick Switcher
- Ctrl+L — focus Address Bar
- Ctrl+R — reload
- Alt+← / Alt+→ — back/forward

Hotkeys Manager lets you create custom shortcuts.

sections.title: FAQ
sections.content:
**Can I open the app on a second monitor?**
Yes – use Single App Mode.

**Can I disable AdBlocker for a single profile?**
Yes – in ProfileModal.

**Can I export my settings?**
Yes – in Settings → Export/Import.

**Can I change the theme?**
Yes – Settings → Theme.
